title: GTA V Wasted
blurb: WASTED — the Grand Theft Auto death sting, complete with that instantly recognizable thud of failure. The meme format writes itself: apply to any real-world faceplant, rejection, or moment of defeat, ideally with the grayscale filter implied. It's the most cinematic way to announce that someone just got absolutely folded by life. A fail-compilation essential.
origin: The death/arrest sting from Grand Theft Auto V (Rockstar, 2013).
